extracted.intended_audience: patent practitioners or registrants seeking reinstatement to practice before the USPTO; counsel handling disciplinary/reinstatement petitions
extracted.subtask_description: Evaluation of a petition for reinstatement to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office under the Office of Enrollment and Discipline procedures (referencing 37 C.F.R. § 11.58). The page is a formal decision granting reinstatement after review of the petition, supporting affidavit, and the record material to eligibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing of Petition for Reinstatement
rubrics_metrics.description: Consideration has been given to the Petition for Reinstatement of Darrell N. Fuller received on July 24, 2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The petition must be formally submitted and received by the Office of Enrollment and Discipline; the decision refers to consideration of the petition as the initiating procedural step.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavit submitted pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58
rubrics_metrics.description: Mr. Fuller has filed an Affidavit pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 in support of the Petition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A supporting affidavit under the cited regulation is part of the record considered for reinstatement; compliance with 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 is treated as a required supporting element.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review of petition, supporting affidavit, and all record information material to eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: After careful review of the Petition, the supporting affidavit, and all information in the record material to his eligibility for reinstatement, the Director ... has determined that reinstatement ... is appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Office conducts a comprehensive review of the petition, the affidavit, and any other record material relevant to eligibility — the decision rests on that review of substantive materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Director's discretionary determination of appropriateness
rubrics_metrics.description: The Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline has determined that reinstatement of Mr. Fuller to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office is appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reinstatement is ultimately a discretionary determination by the Director (or delegated official) after review of the materials; the decision may grant or deny the petition based on that determination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formal decision and notice of grant or denial
rubrics_metrics.description: Accordingly, the Petition is hereby GRANTED.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Office issues a formal written decision communicating the outcome (grant or denial) and provides copy/notice to the petitioner; the decision document serves as the official record of the outcome.
